title: All O(1) Data Structure
goal: Maintain string counts with constant-time updates and minimum/maximum-key queries.
strategy: Link nonempty count buckets in increasing order and map each key to its bucket. An increment or decrement moves a key only to a neighboring count bucket; the two list ends expose the extremes.

edgeCases: Empty extreme queries return empty strings
Several keys can share one count bucket
Decrementing can recreate a missing intermediate bucket
